summary: Houthi forces launched a major missile and drone barrage targeting Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, prompting Saudi civil defense warnings in Abha and Najran. Iran reportedly downed a US MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz and struck a disabled Panama-flagged tanker off Oman. In Gaza, Israel eliminated a Hamas military commander in northern Gaza City while Maglan commandos conducted a deep operation in Lebanon's Al-Khiam.
key_points: Houthi forces fired dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, with impacts also reported in Abha. (Source: @asafroz/53407)
Saudi Civil Defense activated early warning systems across southern regions including Najran following the attacks. (Source: @presstv/206765)
Iran's Revolutionary Guard downed a US MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian reports. (Source: @asafroz/53403)
Iran struck the disabled tanker El Gaia with a drone off Oman, per CENTCOM, after an Iranian missile disabled it last month. (Source: @shin_persian/9928)
Hamas military commander Ahmed Al-Batsh was killed in a vehicle strike in northern Gaza City. (Source: @New_security8200/203794)
IDF Maglan commandos operated 13km deep in Lebanon, dismantling Hezbollah positions in Al-Khiam and capturing the city in under two days. (Source: @idf_telegram/25124)
UK is reviewing Saudi requests for military support against Houthis, including defense of oil infrastructure and preventing advances toward Bab el-Mandeb. (Source: @SharghDaily/183768)
UAE announced two soldiers killed in a training accident. (Source: @asafroz/53409)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous Houthi mass missile-drone attack on Saudi air infrastructure and Iran's downing of a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz indicate a coordinated escalation axis targeting Western and Gulf energy security. Israel's deep raid into Lebanon demonstrates sustained offensive capacity against Hezbollah despite northern front tensions. The killing of a senior Hamas commander in Gaza suggests continued Israeli intelligence penetration. Iran's rejection of negotiations until its conditions are met, coupled with tanker strikes, signals a strategy of maritime pressure. The UK's potential military deepening in Saudi Arabia risks expanding external involvement in the Red Sea corridor.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia has activated civil defense systems across its southern regions and is securing enhanced UK military advisory support. The Mecca Alliance framework between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey is being promoted as a collective security mechanism. Iran is leveraging asymmetric maritime attacks and diplomatic intransigence to reshape Strait of Hormuz dynamics. Gulf states are balancing between US security guarantees and regional de-escalation efforts. The UAE's training casualties highlight ongoing force readiness challenges.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Houthi barrage on Khamis Mushait likely utilized Iranian-supplied ballistic missiles and drones, given the range and coordination. Iran's MQ-1 shoot-down suggests improved air defense coverage over the Strait. The El Gaia strike indicates persistent Iranian targeting of commercial shipping. Israel's Maglan operation reveals detailed intelligence on Hezbollah's Al-Khiam dispositions. The Hamas commander's elimination points to effective Israeli targeting in northern Gaza. China's denial of involvement in Jordan base targeting reflects Beijing's desire to avoid direct attribution. The UK-Saudi military consultation signals a potential shift from arms sales to operational partnership.
